tasks.gr7-integers-t4: Topic: Integers. Cover number-line representation, ordering, and all four operations with positive and negative values. Ask Grade 7 learners to apply sign rules and solve contextual integer scenarios accurately.
tasks.gr7-patterns-functions-and-algebra-conso: Topic: Patterns, functions and algebra consolidation. Cover numeric pattern rules, function tables, algebraic expressions, and equation solving at increased difficulty. Ask Grade 7 learners to connect symbolic and tabular reasoning to determine unknown values.
tasks.gr7-data-handling-t4: Topic: Data handling. Cover collecting, organising, representing, and interpreting data in tables, bar graphs, and pie charts. Ask Grade 7 learners to calculate simple summaries such as mode, median, and range and draw justified conclusions.
tasks.gr7-probability-t4: Topic: Probability. Cover simple experiments, equally likely outcomes, sample space, and relative frequency. Ask Grade 7 learners to calculate basic probabilities, compare likely events, and relate experimental outcomes to theoretical chance.
